form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed figures. Amounts are printed with a single decimal place ('2623.5') exactly as shown - not normalized to 2623.50. The Office field reads simply 'Auditor' (index.csv says 'County Auditor' - a naming-convention difference, not a conflict). No political-party field on this form. Street address, city/state/zip and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars), so residence_city is ''. This v. 4.20 form carries a 'Seven days preceding Convention' option that the later v. 12.23 form does not; that option is the one marked. The cover page header names Clerk/Auditor Josh Daniels while the summary page header names Amelia Powers Gardner - the county reissued the form mid-cycle; both are the form's own printed letterhead.

notes: The chunk listed pages 7 and 9 as summary pages, but page 9 is the county's internal 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' (two staff review sign-offs dated 4/4/22), not a second report. ONE report only; page 7 is the sole Summary Page.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and nothing on the filing is marked in-kind: the v. 4.20 blank has no in-kind checkbox column and neither schedule carries an in-kind word, note or annotation in any cell. Both conventions give the identical sums (2623.50 / 2623.50) and both close. Tested on this filing, not carried from the other v. 4.20 filings in this chunk.
itemized.escalation_note: Two 900 dpi escalations, taken for the geometry proof rather than to settle a glyph — this is a born-digital fillable form printed and scanned, and every figure is machine type, legible at 200 dpi. Worth recording as a reading, not a doubt: this filer types amounts with a TRAILING SINGLE DECIMAL where the cents are round-tenths ('97.5' on Schedule B row 7, and the summary boxes '2623.5' throughout) while writing full cents elsewhere ('504.08', '658.32'). Both forms are transcribed exactly as printed, and no figure was padded to two decimal places.

itemized.notes: Taylor Williams, 2022 cycle, 'Seven days preceding Convention' (radio filled on p1); amendment answered 'No'; Date and Date of Report both 4/1/2022. Born-digital fillable modern_boxAF form, footer-printed 'v. 4.20' on all four report pages, printed and scanned. ⚠ CORRECTION TO THE LAUNCH BRIEF — THIS FILING'S OFFICE BOX DOES NOT CONTAIN A STREET ADDRESS. The chunk launch brief flagged a14994b8 as one of the module's honestly-unresolved offices on the ground that 'its Office box contains a street address, which is not an office claim'. Read on the page, the Office box plainly prints the single word 'Auditor', corroborated by the filer's own email in the adjacent cell ('Auditor@TaylorWilliams.vote'), and it AGREES with index.csv's 'County Auditor'. The module's own unresolved list names a 2022 filer 'Taylor' — a different person from this Taylor WILLIAMS — so the pointer was a name collision, the fourth-plus instance of the ADDENDUM H2 class (a specimen-by-name pointer wrong while the rule holds). No office was inferred here; the page face states it. THE FILING IS A DUPLEX SCAN (ADDENDUM J3): 10 PDF pages = 5 SHEETS, every report page followed by a genuinely blank verso — p1 cover / p2 blank / p3 Schedule A / p4 blank / p5 Schedule B / p6 blank / p7 Summary Page / p8 blank / p9 CHECKLIST / p10 blank. All ten pages were read full-page and all five versos are blank. pdfinfo's page count is therefore NOT the filing's length. pdfinfo: 10 pages, letter, ALL /Rotate 0 — read before measuring per K1. Pages classified BY CONTENT from their own printed headings, never by ordinal. THE CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND AT p9 — the last content sheet, TWO sheets after the genuine Summary Page at p7, which weakens the 'immediately after the summary' tendency further than ADDENDUM L4 already did. It is the HOLD-revision layout (Website / Network / HOLD corner box) but with ALL THREE CORNER BOXES UNTICKED, unlike the two other checklists in this chunk which have 'Website' ticked; it carries every summary-page label, ZERO dollar figures, and two staff-signed review copies (Staff Signature #1 in red dated 4/4/22; Staff Signature #2 in purple dated 4/4/2022 — same day, unlike the 4/4 + 4/6 pairs on the Tribe and Wabel filings). FOLIATION: the filer left every 'Page' box BLANK on all four report sheets — so the document is unfoliated and page ordinals locate nothing here. TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES ALTERNATE SHEET BY SHEET (ADDENDUM L6): p1 cover and p5 Schedule B are headed 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' while p3 Schedule A and p7 Summary Page are headed 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' — the previous Clerk's stock interleaved with the current one inside a single filing, the same phenomenon seen on the Tribe filing in this chunk. ROW-INDEX TRAPS: all six screened, none present — first entry on band 1 on both schedules (crop-proved), no continuation lines, no voided rows, no banner, the one-band-past controls rendered empty on both pages, and both pages returned a complete rule set so no band is doubled. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed — Schedule B's Provider/Vendor cells hold vendors (Marketing Policy Center, McNeil Printing, SendGrid, CallHub, Skymailint, Utah County Elections) plus one individual, and the Purpose cells hold purposes; assignable by content, not by position. SUMMARY-BOX PAIRING SCREEN (ADDENDUM L1): both sides carry the identical 2623.5, so arithmetic alone could not see a crossed pairing — the pairing is confirmed by CONTENT (Schedule A holds one named individual donor; Schedule B holds nine vendors and services) and by each sheet's own printed heading. PRIVACY: the county redacted the candidate's own address block and signature on p1 and the street portion of the single donor address cell on p3; a bare zip survives and was not converted into a city. Note also that the county's redaction pass left YELLOW HIGHLIGHTS on two printed field labels ('Signature' on p1, 'Provider/Vendor' on p5) — clerk working marks on the published document, recorded as an observation.
